baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verse classifies night, day, sun, and moon as signs, then redirects the repeated prostration construction from sun and moon to their creator.
baseline_models.mechanism: The four highly visible phenomena supply evidence, while creation supplies their dependence. Repeating the two luminaries on the prohibited side and naming their creator on the commanded side distinguishes sign from source without denying the signs' force.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes a publicly legible mark and makes indication, rather than self-sufficient power, the phenomena's function.
The branch supplies the solar body and its light as the conspicuous sign that can be mistaken for its source.
The branch supplies the lunar body and its light as a second conspicuous but dependent sign.
The branch contributes origination and assigns productive agency to God rather than to the visible products.
The branch contributes bodily lowering and dependent submission, whose recipient the parallel commands explicitly transfer.

changed_reading.before: A prohibition against two particular astral cult objects.
changed_reading.after: An anti-category-error rule: the most compelling visible order remains evidence, and submission must pass through the evidence to its maker.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same prostration root occurs first under prohibition and then under command, followed by the conditional claim of worship.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse does not abolish creaturely lowliness; it transfers its allegiance. Worship names durable obedient service, so the contrast concerns who receives embodied dependence rather than whether dependence exists.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies humble submission on both sides of the recipient switch and makes the redirection structurally visible.
The branch joins deity and worship and identifies the proper terminus of the transferred submission.
The branch contributes obedient devotion and expands a single prostration into an enduring allegiance.
The branch contributes an actual state in time, making the closing condition test lived worship rather than a label alone.

changed_reading.before: Do not perform one posture toward the wrong objects.
changed_reading.after: Retain embodied dependence but relocate its governing allegiance to God, with actual worship tested as a continuing state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The solar and lunar lights stand beside a prostration root whose inventory includes a lowered, lingering gaze.
baseline_models.mechanism: Visible brilliance can command attention before it receives ritual action. The lunar branch of visually bewildering brightness and the prostration branch of sustained downcast looking permit an exploratory perceptual layer: captivated seeing can rehearse submission.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes sight confused by intense whiteness and makes luminous captivation a possible pre-ritual mechanism.
The branch contributes prolonged lowered looking and lets attention itself function as an exploratory mode of bowing.
The branch keeps the captivating objects anchored as readable marks rather than independent themes.

changed_reading.before: Prostration begins when the body assumes a ritual posture.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, prostration can begin when brilliance monopolizes perception; the command redirects attention and judgment as well as the body.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier creation scene places God's making of the earth against human making of counter-equals. The focus prohibition now exposes astral worship as an attribution people manufacture inside the created field, not a power the luminaries possess.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes divine origination of the earth and fixes one side of the maker-made asymmetry.
The branch contributes human assignment of a new status and makes rivalhood an imposed relation.
The branch contributes a matching opponent and specifies the false parity produced by that assignment.
The branch repeats origination at the focus and places both luminaries on the made side of the contrast.

structural_cues: 41:9 and 41:37 use the same creator-relative construction before rejecting a rival recipient.
The earlier sequence juxtaposes divine creation and human rival-making within one ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation, human status-assignment, and a counter-equal; I infer that the latter manufactures the category error exposed at 41:37. A live alternative is that the rival language concerns cult competitors generally without emphasizing the human production of their status.

changed_reading.before: Sun and moon happen to be incorrect recipients.
changed_reading.after: The worshipper manufactures parity for created signs; the focus command dismantles that assigned equivalence by restoring the maker-made asymmetry.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heaven and earth answer a command with compliance, then the heavens are completed and furnished with lights. The focus luminaries consequently read as participants and instruments within a command-responsive cosmos; human prostration joins that order instead of enthroning one of its instruments.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes willing compliance and gives the created cosmos an obedient rather than sovereign posture.
The branch contributes completed workmanship and places the heavenly order under an executed design.
The branch contributes lamp-like lights and frames luminous bodies as furnished functions within the heavens.
The branch supplies the focus luminary whose light is reassigned from sovereign object to cosmic instrument.
The branch contributes submission and lets the human command answer the cosmos's prior compliance.

structural_cues: 41:11 personifies heaven and earth as jointly addressed respondents.
41:12 and 41:37 both use feminine plural reference for created cosmic entities.
The creation block precedes the focus's night-day and sun-moon pairs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic command, compliance, completion, and furnished lights; I infer that sun and moon belong to this obedient infrastructure and model the submission demanded from humans. A live alternative is that the lamps are stars and that cosmic compliance describes formation rather than worship.

changed_reading.before: The creator merely owns the luminaries and therefore deserves worship.
changed_reading.after: The luminaries inhabit and display an already obedient cosmos; prostrating to God aligns the human with the order the luminaries serve.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing, sight, and skin testify, and God makes every thing articulate after creating humans. This judicial animation sharpens the focus signs into witnesses: created entities can disclose truth, but a witness is not the judge or the proper recipient of worship.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes present witnessing and turns created faculties into evidence-bearing agents.
The branch contributes intelligible indication and links creaturely speech to the broader function of signs.
The branch contributes comprehensive inclusion and extends articulate dependence across created things.
The branch contributes origination and keeps the speaking witnesses dependent on the one who enables them.
The branch contributes the focus category of visible marks and receives the judicial witness function.

structural_cues: 41:20 lists bodily faculties as witnesses against their owner.
41:21 universalizes articulation to every thing and immediately recalls creation.
41:37 labels cosmic entities as signs before naming their creator.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created faculties that testify and universalizes their articulation; I infer that the focus luminaries likewise function as witness-like signs whose testimony redirects beyond them. A live alternative confines the speech scene to eschatological bodily evidence.

changed_reading.before: The celestial objects are silent exhibits that merely point.
changed_reading.after: The created order is witness-like: its disclosure is forceful enough to testify, yet that very testimony distinguishes it from the creator and judge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Signs can be bent away from their proper direction, while signs across distant horizons and the self progressively disclose truth. The focus prohibition therefore governs how signs are read: stopping at sun or moon converts a directional mark into a terminal object.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes deviation from a straight course and makes misuse of signs a directional failure.
The branch contributes manifest marks across a widened evidentiary field and reconnects directly to the focus category.
The branch contributes distant outer directions and extends the focus's cosmic evidence beyond two luminaries.
The branch contributes the self itself and pairs inner evidence with the outer horizon.
The branch contributes emergence into clarity and gives the distributed signs a disclosure process.
The branch contributes reality firmly matching what is the case and supplies the signs' destination.
The branch contributes submission and marks the practical consequence of either stopping or following the evidentiary direction.

structural_cues: 41:40 speaks of deviation within the signs.
41:53 pairs outer horizons with inner selves and gives their showing a clarity endpoint.
41:37 first calls the phenomena signs and then redirects prostration beyond them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deviation, marks, outer and inner fields, progressive clarity, and truth; I infer a semiotic vector from sign to referent. A live alternative takes deviation as general doctrinal distortion and the final showing as corroboration without a directional model.

changed_reading.before: A list of natural wonders followed by a ritual restriction.
changed_reading.after: A discipline of world-reading: receive visible things as directional evidence, and do not collapse the pointer into the reality to which it leads.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah presents blindness as something preferred over guidance, then depicts noise used to defeat hearing and a weight in the ears paired with inward blindness. These choices strengthen the focus-only possibility that worship begins as captured attention: love, noise, and brilliance can subordinate perception before the body bows.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes gentle direction toward truth and supplies the perceptual path that blindness displaces.
The branch contributes attachment lodged in the heart and makes misperception an appetite rather than a passive deficit.
The branch contributes blindness of inner discernment and turns the chosen attachment into epistemic submission.
The branch contributes mixed disruptive noise and shows attention being deliberately occupied to block reception.
The branch contributes overpowering force and reveals control of attention as a strategy of rule.
The branch contributes auditory heaviness and completes the packet's sensory-blockage pattern.
The branch contributes visually bewildering brightness and anchors sensory capture in a named focus luminary.
The branch contributes lingering lowered vision and permits attentional surrender to function as an exploratory prostration.

structural_cues: 41:17 makes blindness the object of preference over guidance.
41:26 explicitly links engineered noise to prevailing over hearers.
41:20-22 and 41:44 repeatedly coordinate hearing, sight, and moral accountability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preferred blindness, attachment, engineered noise, sensory weight, and focus branches of bewildered and lingering sight; I infer a path from occupied perception to allegiance. A live alternative restricts prostration to ritual posture and treats the sensory passages as separate failures of reception.

changed_reading.before: The prohibition concerns bodily worship after a belief has already formed.
changed_reading.after: Before the body bows, perception may already be ruled; the command also contests what captures gaze, hearing, love, and judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, nearby servants glorify through night and day without tiring. Later, the human does not tire of asking for good, yet turns aside and distances himself after favor and expands prayer under harm. The closing condition in the focus becomes a constancy audit: what persists across the cycle, worship of God or pursuit of benefit?

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes worshipful glorification and supplies the enduring activity paired with the focus's command.
The branch contributes weariness from duration or repetition, whose negation marks constancy in service.
The same branch contributes untiring repetition, now attached to acquisitive petition and enabling the behavioral contrast.
The branch contributes calling by speech and identifies desired benefit as the tireless human pursuit.
The branch contributes favorable condition and supplies the benefit after which the human relation changes.
The branch contributes turning one's side away and exposes withdrawal once the sought benefit is present.
The branch contributes active distancing and intensifies the break between received favor and continuing allegiance.
The branch contributes one half of the recurring temporal cycle across which allegiance is tested.
The branch contributes the opening daylight half of the cycle and completes the measure of constancy.
The branch contributes obedient devotion and makes the focus's condition the category being behaviorally tested.

structural_cues: 41:38 immediately repeats night and day after the focus and negates weariness.
41:49 repeats the same weariness root but attaches tirelessness to asking for benefit.
41:51 sequences favor, turning away, harm, and extended prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition, temporal continuity, untiring glorification, untiring request, and benefit-dependent withdrawal; I infer a deliberate diagnostic contrast that sharpens the focus's conditional clause. A live alternative treats the two negated-weariness statements as independent descriptions of different groups.

changed_reading.before: The closing condition only asks whether the stated recipient is God.
changed_reading.after: The condition tests allegiance by duration and reversal: worship persists through night, day, favor, and harm, while appetite persists only around what it wants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next sign-scene shows earth in a lowered, hushed state, then descending water makes it move, rise, and live. Set beside the focus prostration, humility is no longer merely static abasement: creaturely lowering can be a receptive posture from which the creator activates life.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes low, quiet submission and supplies the earth's receptive initial posture.
The branch contributes delivery from above and introduces the enabling input into the lowered earth.
The branch contributes earth and vegetation stirring with life and turns still humility into animated response.
The branch contributes land revived through growth and assigns the sequence's life-giving agency to God.
The branch contributes humble lowering and receives the adjacent earth sequence as a functional analogy.
The branch contributes divine origination and keeps receptivity directed to the creator rather than to the natural medium.

structural_cues: 41:39 immediately resumes the sign formula used in 41:37.
The earth sequence moves from lowered stillness through received water to motion and life.
The reviver is identified by a creator-relative construction analogous to the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lowered earth, descending water, stirring, and revival; I infer a functional arrow from humble receptivity to creator-enabled animation. A live alternative reads the lowered state simply as dry stillness, with no analogy to human prostration.

changed_reading.before: Prostration is static abasement before superior power.
changed_reading.after: In the adjacent sign ecology, proper lowering is receptive rather than lifeless: it opens created agency to animation from the creator.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later action returns as benefit or burden to the actor, and the Lord is denied unjust treatment of servants. This revises the servitude register in the focus: worship of the creator is not an extractive transfer that enriches a master but an allegiance whose moral consequences accrue to the worshipper and release created things from mastery.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes intentional action and supplies the agency whose consequences return to its doer.
The branch contributes fitness for a purpose and characterizes beneficial action as alignment rather than tribute.
The branch contributes the actor's own self and locates the benefit of right action with that self.
The branch contributes putting something outside its proper place or time and excludes misplacement from divine treatment.
The branch contributes the owned-servant register and makes the denial of exploitative treatment directly relevant to focus worship.
The branch contributes obedient devotion and receives the later self-return and justice constraints.

structural_cues: 41:46 balances action for the self against action upon the self.
The ayah closes with the servant root used by the focus's worship verb.
The divine title is paired with an explicit denial of unjust treatment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-returning consequences, purposive fitness, servants, and denial of misplaced treatment; I infer that divine worship is non-extractive and frees the worshipper from granting mastery to creatures. A live alternative limits the verse to fairness in final judgment without revising the social register of worship.

changed_reading.before: Worship resembles a demand imposed by an owner upon dependents.
changed_reading.after: Allegiance to the creator does not enrich Him at the servant's expense; it orders the servant's own agency and refuses mastery to created signs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus noun plainly denotes the astronomical sun while the hostility branch is form-distant. It remains anchored in the supplied sun root and in 41:34's explicit enemy-to-ally mechanism, but downstream prose should present it only as a social branch echo, never as a translation or primary identification of the sun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sun root's hostility branch stands inside the prohibition on lowering oneself to the sun.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes openly displayed hostility and permits glaring power to echo the named luminary.
The branch contributes self-lowering and supplies the social act that hostile power might demand.
The branch contributes active enmity and grounds the outlier in an explicit hostile relation.
The branch contributes pushing harm away and provides an alternative to either submission or mirrored hostility.
The branch contributes protective affection and supplies the transformed social endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The sun is only an astronomical idol in a cultic prohibition.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch echo, the verse also resists lowering oneself to glaring hostile power; God-directed submission enables a better response that can transform the relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 41:29 concerns condemned human or hidden misleaders, not celestial bodies. It remains anchored through the focus prostration root and the packet's explicit below-feet spatial branches, but downstream prose should qualify it as a vertical analogy about assigned rank, not as an equation of the sun and moon with those misleaders.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus decides where the body may lower itself; the outlier tracks the later reversal of falsely elevated guides to a place below the feet.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes bending and lowering the head and supplies the focus's vertical act.
The branch contributes departure from right direction and identifies the agents whose elevated guidance proved false.
The branch contributes assigning something a condition and makes the later low rank an imposed reversal.
The branch contributes a position underneath and supplies the reversed vertical relation.
The branch contributes the bodily foot and concretizes the demotion of former guides.

changed_reading.before: Bowing to a created object is an isolated ritual mistake.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial analogy, false elevation creates an unstable hierarchy later inverted underfoot; the focus preempts that reversal by reserving voluntary lowering for God.

strongest_changes: The maker-made distinction became a diagnosis of humanly manufactured parity, not merely a list of forbidden recipients.
The creation sequence made sun and moon instruments within an already compliant cosmos, so human prostration joins rather than worships that order.
The horizon-self sequence made signs directional witnesses: stopping at a luminary bends evidence away from its disclosed endpoint.
The repeated no-weariness language turned the closing worship condition into a test of constancy across night, day, favor, and harm.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly converted the focus's compact cultic contrast into mechanisms of created dependence, testimony, attention, temporal constancy, receptive humility, and self-returning action while preserving several coexisting readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The attentional reading depends on branch-distant links between bewildered sight, lowered looking, and the surah's sensory failures; ritual prostration remains the primary literal layer.
The earth's lowered-to-living sequence may be only temporal juxtaposition rather than a causal model of receptive humility.
The hostile-glare and inverted-hierarchy readings are valid only as contained branch echoes and should not be promoted into lexical translations.
